title: Freya JSON Output
description: Canonical schema for the JSON emitted by `hexdek-freya --format json`. Pins the stable top-level invariants downstream consumers (Decks-screen panel, hat strategy bridge, BlueFrog deck-import, archetype-correction training-log, composition-prior validation) depend on. `additionalProperties: true` is intentional throughout — Freya routinely grows new fields and the schema's job is to catch DROPPED or RENAMED required fields, not to forbid additions. Validate with `freya --validate-output` after a `--format json` run. The shape mirrors the jsonReport struct in cmd/hexdek-freya/report.go (snake_case via json tags), NOT the raw FreyaReport struct (PascalCase Go field names).

deck_path.description: Absolute path of the source deck file. Omitted (omitempty) for in-memory analyses.

commander.description: Detected commander card name. Omitted when no commander could be identified.

total_cards.description: Card count after deck list parsing (sum of quantities, includes the commander).

true_infinites.description: Mandatory-loop combos. The deck cannot avoid the loop firing once pieces are present and untapped — game draws or ends.

determined_loops.description: Player-choice loop combos. The pilot decides whether to iterate; loops are bounded by intent.

finishers.description: Single-card or small-package finishers without a closing loop.

synergies.description: Non-winning value pairs/triples — engine pieces that don't close on their own.

cards.description: Piece names. Every combo carries at least one card name.

loop_type.description: Loop semantics — gates how the bracket scorer + win-line analyzer treat the entry.

class.description: What the combo produces (infinite_mana / infinite_drain / library_exile_win / etc.). May be empty until ClassifyComboHeuristic runs.
